results.title: Sainte Trinité X
results.overview: Billie, William, and Aurélie are three best friends who share the same profession: sex work. Billie has an audition that could change her life, but tonight she’s joining her friends on stage for their final show together.

results.title: HELP
results.overview: An exhausted nurse slaughters what she thinks is a horrifying bloody mangled monster to survive the night, but the truth she uncovers in the aftermath is far more horrifying than any creature.

results.title: Water For The Birds
results.overview: A lost backpack sets young Amin on a daring journey, testing the limits of familial love and personal sacrifice.

results.title: Hallway Monitor
results.overview: George's sister is sick. Trying his best to take care of her, the twelve year old boy spends all hospital visits inspecting the hallway for anything that might put her in danger. When his routine inspection is interrupted, George must face the danger all around him.

results.title: Trance
results.overview: Yasmin works as a paramedic while caring for her sick mother and nine-year-old sister Ayla. Financial pressure pushes her into an extra shift. During a 24-hour duty, mistakes pile up. When she takes Ayla along in the ambulance, the next call is a resuscitation - and Yasmin loses control. Suddenly, she is her own emergency.

results.title: The Stationary Traveler
results.overview: Two filmmakers propose to Cristián Sánchez, a cult Chilean director, to make a film. The condition is that he resurrects the characters of his classic works, but in the form of zombies. He fights to protect his artistic principles but ends up trapped in his own film.

results.title: The Run
results.overview: In a dystopian, post-pandemic world crippled by a global fertility crisis, an aging smuggler struggles to protect a runaway teenager and her newborn baby from ruthless criminals, while trying to complete his run for his vicious employers.

results.title: The Heir
results.overview: A grieving granddaughter inherits her grandmother’s home in a gentrifying D.C. neighborhood, where family tensions and generational scars force her to choose between preserving tradition or redefining legacy.

results.title: Murder Boy
results.overview: Celo's birthday night turns sinister after she discovers her boyfriend Montey may be leaving her for another woman. When the mysterious Margaret Wellington enters her life, Celo is drawn into a disturbing world of control, ritual, and devotion.

results.title: AEW All Out 2026
results.overview: The 2026 All Out was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on September 26, 2026, at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, USA. The show was headlined by an AEW World Title match between current Champion Will Ospreay and challenger Jon Moxley.

results.title: The Golden Grip
results.overview: In the mid-1960s, Kostas left his village in Crete dreaming of becoming a star. His rugged physique and humble background afforded him only small “tough-guy” roles, yet in numerous Greek films – from big studio productions and renowned auteur masterpieces to low-budget exploitation films alike. By placing a support actor at centerstage, the film traces five decades of Greek cinema.

results.title: La Pietà
results.overview: At the foot of Europe’s largest glacier, seven Icelandic siblings once lived in deliberate isolation, dedicating their lives to observing ice and nature long before climate change had a name. Their abandoned farmhouse becomes a living archive, animated by photographs, objects, and a 16mm film that restores gestures, spaces, and a vanished way of being in the world.

results.title: Gonzaga: The Slipper Still Fits
results.overview: Documentary centers on how head coach Mark Few turned the small college program into a national powerhouse that became a regular contender in the NCAA Division I men’s basketball tournament known as March Madness.

results.title: Aussie at Heart
results.overview: Samara, a former lawyer now event planner, reunites with Nate, her ex‑coworker and rival, to plan a couple's anniversary in Queensland and begin to confront their past and fall for each other.

results.title: Zrinski
results.overview: The Zrinski family lineage had produced many great warriors, lovers and even political conspirators. However, the first to put it on the map was Nikola the Seventh Zrinski, who political influence, military prowess and poetic skills made him one of the most influential figures in Europe at the time. In this new docudrama, his life comes on screen for the very first time.

results.title: Dirty Hands
results.overview: In the underbelly of Chicago, a routine drug deal goes bad for the Denton brothers, Richie and Danny. With a kingpin’s son murdered, a rival gang out for blood, and their own boss trying to clean up their mess, the brothers must fight for their lives if they’re going to survive until morning.

results.title: Le miracle
results.overview: After Angelica is disturbed by her adult son Mattia in her relaxation bath, she is finally able to let go. She begins to masturbate in front of the poster of footballer Valenti, her son's idol. Suddenly, Valenti's gaze fixes on her… a cry for help. An absurd euphoria spreads: the miracle crystallises into a struggle for power and intimacy between mother and son.

results.title: Julien Doré - Le Dernier Pestacle
results.overview: Filmed during the final date of his triumphant tour, Julien Doré’s concert is being shown exclusively in cinemas for a one-night-only event. A monumental show. A spectacular and immersive stage production. In a rich visual universe that is both poetic and dreamlike, blending humor and emotion, each song becomes a living tableau, alternating between grand, awe-inspiring moments and more intimate ones. Applauded by more than one million spectators, this unforgettable tour, which has become iconic, comes to a close on the big screen, offering one last moment of escape.
